correctness.rationale: For the two-dimensional nonassociative evolution algebra e1²=e2, e2²=e1+e2, e1e2=0, every nonzero vector has nonzero square and there is no proper nonzero ideal. Direct multiplication shows one-dimensional subalgebras are exactly K(e1+t e2) for P(t)=t³-t²-1=0; all nonzero endomorphisms are id and all derivations zero. Invertible weight-one RB operators reduce to endomorphisms via 1+R^-1, giving -id. Rank-one weight-one image/kernel are distinct subalgebra lines, so solutions are exactly minus projections between ordered distinct roots (plus 0), scaled by lambda; count 2+m(m-1). Weight-zero invertibles are impossible (inverse derivation); rank-one maps require im=ker line and 3t=2, forcing P(2/3)=-31/27=0, hence characteristic 31, where c[[-11,1],[-121,11]] is the square-zero line. I independently enumerated all 2x2 matrices for fields F3,F5,F7 with direct basis RB products for weights 0,1; each matched predicted sets. Independently checked P factors as (t-11)^2(t-10) mod31 and its discriminant -31. Field extensions and infinite fields follow from algebra, not finite tests.
